answer_1.quote: We perform our experimental evaluations on two open-ended generation tasks: summarization via CNN-DM (See et al., 2017), a collection of English news articles written by journalists at CNN and the Daily Mail, and longform question-answering via PubMedQA (Jin et al., 2019), a dataset from the biomedical domain and contexts available.

answer_2.quote: For similarity, we employed F1 ROUGE-L ) and F1 BERTScore  to measure lexical and semantic similarity between the response and the reference, respectively. For faithfulness, we used FactKB  to measure the faithfulness of the response to the context.
